definedTerms.definition: “Affiliate” means any entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with a Party, where “control” means ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting shares of the entity.
“control” means ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting shares of the entity.
“Applicable Law” means all laws, regulations and guidelines that apply to the manufacture, supply or use of the Product.
“Firm Order” means a Purchase Order that Supplier has accepted under Section 3.3.
“Forecast” means the rolling forecast that Buyer provides under Section 3.1.
“Product” means the CliniSep reagent kits and buffers listed in Exhibit A.
“Quality Agreement” means the quality agreement between the Parties dated as of the Effective Date, as amended from time to time.
“Specifications” means the specifications for the Product set out in the Quality Agreement.
“Supply Failure” means Supplier’s failure to deliver at least eighty percent (80%) of the quantity of Product ordered under Firm Orders in any two (2) consecutive calendar quarters.
“Confidential Information” means any non-public information that a Party discloses to the other Party under this Agreement.
This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for five (5) years (the “Term”).
